Physical_Theory_and_Basis: Matched asymptotic expansions of Stokes / boundary layer equations for a marine ice sheet
Sliding_Law_Dependency: Weertman power-law sliding: tau_b = C_bed * |u|^(m-1) * u. If Coulomb / plastic sliding is used, exponent changes drastically.
Rheology_Dependency: Glen's flow law: epsilon_dot = A * tau^n (typically n=3). Ice stiffness A depends exponentially on temperature via Arrhenius relation.
Dimensionality_and_Geometry: STRICTLY 1D FLOWLINE with semi-infinite unbuttressed ice shelf and laterally uniform channel width.
Lateral_Shear_and_Bridging: ASSUMES ZERO LATERAL SHEAR. Cannot resolve lateral drag from shear margins in narrow fjords.
Buttressing_Treatment: Introduces a boundary back-force parameter; Pegler (2018) showed buttressing modifies effective thickness scaling by theta^(n/(m+1)).
Applicability_to_Peninsula_Basins: APPROXIMATE (Valid only as an integrated flowline proxy for outlet glaciers; requires calibrated width and lateral friction factors).

Physical_Theory_and_Basis: Lumped-parameter power-law scaling anchored to historical baseline discharge D_0
Sliding_Law_Dependency: Absorbed into baseline discharge D_0 and effective exponent gamma.
Rheology_Dependency: Absorbed into D_0 and temperature-dependent sensitivity term.
Lateral_Shear_and_Bridging: Implicitly represented through the scalar buttressing term theta_buttress(t) and minimum limit theta_min.
Buttressing_Treatment: Explicit scalar multiplier mapping [0, 1] to a 2x to 8x acceleration factor.
Applicability_to_Peninsula_Basins: FEASIBLE AS REDUCED PROXY IF CALIBRATED AGAINST HISTORICAL DATA; must NOT be claimed as full 3D Stokes physics.

Physical_Theory_and_Basis: Marine Ice Sheet Instability (Weertman 1974; Schoof 2007; Pattyn 2017)
Mathematical_Formula: dq_GL / dx_GL = (dq_GL / dh_GL) * (dh_GL / dx_GL) = gamma * (q_GL / h_GL) * [ -(rho_w / rho_ice) * (db/dx) ]
Sliding_Law_Dependency: Unstable whenever db/dx < 0 (retrograde bed) under unbuttressed conditions, regardless of sliding law.
Rheology_Dependency: Controls rate of retreat, not neutral stability boundary.
Lateral_Shear_and_Bridging: Gudmundsson (2013) proved sufficient lateral buttressing can STABILIZE retrograde slopes.
Buttressing_Treatment: Loss of buttressing (theta -> 0) triggers MISI runaway on retrograde sections of George VI and Crane troughs.
Applicability_to_Peninsula_Basins: ESSENTIAL DYNAMIC MECHANISM: Explains sustained post-2002 loss in Ipp-J and potential instability in West Palmer Land (Hp-I).
